python.signature: client.events.ingest(*, events: list[Event], allow_backfilling=..., allow_partial_failures=...) -> IngestEventsResponse

samples.python:
from meteroid.models import Event

ingest_events_response = client.events.ingest(
    events=[
        Event(
            code="code",
            customer_id="customer_id",
            event_id="event_id",
            timestamp="2026-01-15T10:30:00Z",
        ),
    ],
)

operations.description:
Ingest usage events for metering and billing purposes.

Events are deduplicated by `(event_id, customer_id)` — re-sending the same pair will not be
double-counted. If timestamps differ across duplicates, the event with the latest timestamp is used.

By default, any invalid event rejects the entire batch. Set `allow_partial_failures` to `true` to ingest valid events and receive per-event failure details in the response body.

responses.description: Bad request, including a feature that is unknown or outside the product

samples.python:
from meteroid.models import EntitlementSpecRequest

entitlement_list_response = client.products.entitlements.create(
    "prd_7n42DGM5Tflk9n8mt7Fhc7",
    entitlements=[
        EntitlementSpecRequest(feature_id="feature_id"),
    ],
)

operations.description:
A product has no entitlement rows of its own: its entitlements are the feature-level
defaults of the features scoped to it, which is what `GET` on this path resolves. Every
spec must therefore target a feature belonging to `product_id`. Features that already
carry a default entitlement are skipped.

Specs are validated up front, but the writes are not atomic: each feature is written on
its own, so a failure part-way can leave earlier specs committed. Retrying is safe.

On a PAYMENT: how much was voluntarily given back (the sum of its settled REFUND
children). The invoice stays paid — the Refund credit note is what reduces it.

amount_reversed.description:
On a PAYMENT: how much was involuntarily clawed back (chargeback, bank recall, lost
dispute). This is what the invoice nets out, reopening it.

credit_note_id.description: Set on a REFUND drawn against a finalized Refund credit note.

parent_transaction_id.description: Set on a REFUND: the settled payment the money is given back from.

reversal_reason.description: The provider's raw cause, or what the operator typed when reversing by hand.

value.description: Omit to leave the entitlement unchanged. Must match the feature's type.

webhooks.name: invoice.closed

webhooks.name: invoice.consolidated
webhooks.description: An invoice was merged into a consolidated invoice and is superseded by its parent

webhooks.name: metric.created
webhooks.description: A new billable metric was created

webhooks.name: payment.failed
webhooks.description: A payment attempt was declined or failed; no money moved

webhooks.name: payment.reversed
webhooks.description: A settled payment was clawed back (chargeback, bank recall, lost dispute) and its invoice reopened

webhooks.name: quote.converted
webhooks.description: A quote was converted into subscription

webhooks.name: refund.failed
